input.location: Cape Bluff, Missouri – Main Campus, Health Sciences Campus (2.4 miles east of Main Campus) and Downtown Center
input.notes: Initial term July 1, 2027 – June 30, 2028 plus four (4) one-year renewals, maximum five (5) years (RFP §2.1). Custodial only; exterior walks, steps and parking lots cleared by University Grounds staff (§4.6). Winter entrance/walk-off mat requirements Nov 15 – Mar 15; 5–6 snow/ice events per winter. ~14,200 students, ~3,100 on campus. APPA Level 2 unless Remarks/Exhibit B specify Level 1. Day porters at Student Union and Boreham Library 7:00 AM–3:30 PM M–F (§4.4).

input.notes: Five-year term (one-year initial term + four one-year renewals), July 1, 2022 – June 30, 2027. Contract type not stated. Addendum No. 1 A5: incumbent staffs approximately 78 custodial FTEs (including day porters) and 7 supervisors across all three locations. Invoices not provided (A6). Current contract covers the Exhibit A buildings (scope may differ slightly from the new RFP: 1114 added, 0084 removed).

input.summary: Kessler State University RFP #27031 custodial services: 51 Exhibit A buildings registered across Main, Health Sciences and Downtown Center campuses (gross and cleanable SF, floors, restroom fixtures, service days/week), plus Addendum No. 1 changes: 1114 Ridgeview Commons added (11,000 / 9,350 SF, 7 days), 2210 gross corrected to 42,810 SF, 0084 Hawthorne Hall removed from scope. 0030 Ballman Speer excluded (0 service days, information only). 50 buildings in scope. No grounds scope (exterior walks/parking by University Grounds staff). Incumbent Allpoint Custodial Group, LLC, KSU-C-22-0447, $26,480,000 over 5 years (2022–2027); ~78 custodial FTEs + 7 supervisors.
unresolved: Buildings with 6 service days/week (0036, 0060, 0063, 2213, 3307: Monday–Saturday) were set to service_level daily_5 because no 6-day level exists; service_frequency_text records 6 days/week.

EXH-A printed TOTAL (2,220,646 SF gross) is a simple sum of every Exhibit A row including information-only 0030 and does not reflect Addendum No. 1 (2210 corrected 48,210 → 42,810; 0084 removed; 1114 added), per Addendum A4.
Exhibit B (tasks/frequencies by space type), Exhibit C (staffing workbook) and Exhibit D (pricing pages) are referenced but not included in the package.
Building 1114 Ridgeview Commons use type not stated; categorized as other.
